sourceNotes: Issue #441 first slice: the street-casual adult male patient moves from the Anny rail to a parametric MPFB bake wearing library garments (D9's clothing/body rows). The resolver swap is a separate slice and is deliberately out of scope — the four slots still resolve to adult_male_street_casual.glb when this asset lands.
gender/muscle/weight/proportions/cupsize/firmness remain MPFB defaults — only age + height are driven by reference measurement this slice.
Exact MADR 0051 §5 landmark match (shoulder, girths, limb lengths) is anny-mpfb-landmark-compare's follow-on; NOT claimed here.

Unlocked decisions: skin tone token warm_medium (new SKIN_TONE_RGB row, (0.66,0.50,0.40) — not byte-identical to any other actor's tone); eyes row kept (brown iris, 24.0 mm anatomical eyes — no clause required it, but the actor is an adult and the materializer hard-refuses a missing EYE_DIAMETER_TARGET_MM row).

The manifest's output.obj_path names peds_nurse_kevin.anny_base.obj — a copy defect in the reference manifest; the tracked adult_male_street_casual.anny_base.obj (1.76 m, head-height fraction 0.100) drove the bake, and the manifest's input_params (actor_id patient_luis_martinez_v1, skin_tone warm_medium, fabricPalette olive_knit_and_cream_casual) were consumed as-is.
Baked 2026-08-19 in the issue-441 worktree with the provider caches staged locally (garments incl. .mhmat + declared textures, hair mhair02, iris makehuman-system-assets, visemes02).

Out-of-scope wrongness seen and not fixed: the figure's fit quality (poke-through, waistband gap, hem sawtooth #401) was not re-graded for this new body; the orchestrator grades an isolated lit front still.
